description.value: Hanaya Japanese Restaurant is a Japanese sushi and dining restaurant in Surrey, BC, in operation since at least 2004. It offers dine-in, online ordering, and delivery, making it a practical stop for cyclists looking for a full sit-down Japanese meal. The restaurant is wheelchair accessible and accepts credit and debit cards.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is live and confirms the business is active, providing phone, email, full address with postal code, and navigation items including 'Order Online' and 'Delivery', which confirm takeout capability. OSM tags corroborate the address and add wheelchair=yes, air_conditioning=yes, and smoking=no. No mention of bike-specific amenities, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities anywhere in either source.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone (604) 542-6311 sourced from website only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null as there is no OSM value to compare against.
OSM addr:unit=106 is not reflected in the website address; full address may be Unit 106, 2828 152 St.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Japanese restaurant with a live website, confirmed contact details, and online ordering. A useful food stop for touring cyclists in Surrey.
